title: Thomas Bryant 2021-22 Panini Prizm Green Prizm #7 Washington Wizards
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a rare Thomas Bryant 2021-22 Panini Prizm Green Prizm #7 trading card, perfect for any avid basketball fan. The card features the Washington Wizards player in a short print design, making it a unique addition to your collection. 

This original card is from the Panini Prizm set and is an English language parallel variety. It is not autographed, but the card is a great representation of the player's likeness. The card measures 3½" x 2½" and was manufactured in the United States in 2021. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this rare Thomas Bryant card to your collection!
